identitySignals: Agenda names 'Effective School Solutions, LLC' in New Providence, NJ; the company's own website and public profiles show Effective School Solutions based in New Providence, NJ 07974
Website describes in-school mental health and behavioral support programs for K-12 school districts, consistent with a district Special Education Department services agreement
Website says the company has a Regional Vice President of Programming for California and offers support for California school districts
research.notes: Agenda title spells the name 'Essential School Solutions, LLC (ESS)' while the vendor name is 'Effective School Solutions, LLC'; treated as a typo in the title since the NJ location and ESS abbreviation match. The company's own pages give two different New Providence street addresses (121 Chanlon Road on Who We Are; 430 Mountain Avenue, Suite 304 on the homepage), so address was left null. Registry IDs (EIN, CA entity number, SAM UEI) and exact legal name were not verified in a registry; not found in cited pages.

profile.summary: Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a company that partners with K-12 school districts to provide in-school mental health and behavioral support programs. It focuses on students with the most intensive emotional, mental health and behavioral needs. Its services include clinical programming, crisis response and professional development for educators.

sources.title: Who We Are - Effective School Solutions

review.notes: Cited pages show Effective School Solutions, New Providence NJ, providing in-school mental health and behavioral programs for K-12 districts, with explicit California district support, matching the agenda's LLC, NJ location and ESS abbreviation (the 'Essential' in the item title looks like a typo). Summary, website, phone, generic info@ email and headquarters are all shown on the cited pages; the address was correctly left null because the site lists two street addresses.
